lean.fidelity_note: Theorem 7.1 returns α, its period, a smooth profile and the bounds and symmetries of that same profile. This implication assumes the more restrictive certificate conditions and concludes only existence of a weak recurrent profile; its conclusion does not retain α or the bounds (7.38).
lean.name: Breakdown.extended_certificate_orbit_proved
lean.plain: A certificate gives a weak profile
